card.name: End of a noun phrase before its verb
card.fires_on: The last word or word piece of a noun phrase or name, just before the verb or next clause. Often it is a drug name or dosage form such as 'tablets' or 'USP', in label text.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: The word 'tablets' or a closing piece like 'TS' or 'USP' ending a drug name used as a subject.
modes.example: 5.3 Hypotension Candesartan cilexetil<< tablets>> can cause symptomatic hypotension.

modes.label: End of a heading or long term
modes.description: The last piece of a capitalized warning or a multi-part term, such as 'VIRUS' or 'Inhibitors'.
modes.example: WARNING: SEVERE MUCOCUTANEOUS REACTIONS, HEPATITIS B VIR<<US>> REACTIVATION and PROGRESSIVE

modes.label: Noun ending in general text
modes.description: A noun or name closing a phrase in recipes, scripture or news, right before a verb or dash.
